name: model-card
desc: Free, open-source model card generator for Windows — auto-fill metadata, benchmark tables, license text into clean Markdown. 100 MB MIT.
features: ✅ **Form-based wizard** — fill the fields once, get a complete model card in Hugging Face layout
✅ **Auto-detect from GGUF** — parameter count, context length and quantization pulled straight out of the file
✅ **Benchmark table builder** — add rows of scores with model names and let the table render cleanly
✅ **License helper** — pick a license and the card gets correct usage and restriction text attached
✅ **Live Markdown preview** — rendered card beside the source so formatting errors show immediately
✅ **Template slots** — custom sections saved as snippets for the next model release
✅ **100 MB self-contained exe** — runtime bundled, portable, offline, MIT with SHA-256 releases
compare: | Feature | **model-card** | HF templates | Manual Markdown | Card generators online |
| Price | **Free, MIT** | Free, OSS | Free | Free web |
| GGUF metadata import | **Yes** | No | No | No |
| Benchmark table builder | **Yes** | No | Manual | Partial
| License text helper | **Yes** | No | Manual | No
| Portable, no install | **Yes, 100 MB** | Python env | Editor | Browser
faqQ: how to write a model card for a fine-tuned or quantized LLM?
faqA: Hand-writing cards means hunting for the right template and re-typing parameters that already sit inside the model file. model-card pulls the real numbers from the GGUF and renders a correct card with benchmarks and license text. It is a 100 MB portable exe, MIT, and works offline with nothing to sign up for.
s1: Dark wizard (#121418, pink #F472B6): left column form with model name, base model and license fields, right pane live Markdown preview of the card.
s2: Benchmark table builder: four score rows with model and score columns, add row button, rendered table preview updating below with green check on format.
s3: Export step: save dialog with card.md suggested name, template slot dropdown set to release notes, toast reading card exported with 42 metadata fields.
